trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was the latest release and was unhealthy, as was v2.3.1-rc. v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy release. After the rollback, checkout-api reports healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the incident was created once. Its summary describes the rollback and the follow-up needed: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before releasing it again.
